title: AI booking form — what to build first

state.goal: When AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini) finds a Zenno business through normal web search, it should know the business can be booked directly and book it in the chat, instead of handing the user a link. Zenno is not a destination people or AIs search; each business's own page becomes AI-bookable.
state.founder: Non-technical, wants to launch and sell fast.
state.already_live: Booking engine on Supabase: business details (services, prices, staff, hours), free times, time holds, booking, cancel, Jev check that blocks unclear requests, merchant approval option, merchant emails. Booking currently needs a per-business key.
state.not_live_yet: The frontend (merchant AI booking page, approve page) is built but not released to Vercel. The human booking pages are a JavaScript app, so AI crawlers see almost nothing on them.

parts.get_found: Structured data (schema.org LocalBusiness/HairSalon, services with prices, ReserveAction pointing to the AI booking form) plus llms.txt on every business page, served in the initial HTML so crawlers see it. Runs on Vercel.
parts.free_times_page: A plain, no-JavaScript page per business listing real free times that any AI can read.
parts.one_step_booking: A plain form (name, email, phone, service, time) that a browsing AI agent can fill in, with a JSON twin for API-calling assistants.
parts.keyless_access: Remove the per-business key requirement so any assistant can hold and book, with rate limits and Web Bot Auth verified-agent tier, matching the public human form.

first_part.instructions: Which part in `state.parts` should be built first to get the goal in `state.goal` working soonest?

criteria.get_found: Build the structured data and llms.txt first.
criteria.free_times_page: Build the plain free-times page first.
criteria.one_step_booking: Build the plain booking form first.

ship_as.instructions: Should the four parts ship together or one by one?

criteria.together_as_one_release: Build all four, test end to end, release once, because each part alone does not let an AI book.
criteria.one_by_one: Release each part as soon as it is ready.
